points.quote: Programme handbooks must also clearly outline and communicate the permitted use of GenAI by students in learning activities and assessment tasks
points.gist: Programme handbooks must clearly state the permitted use of GenAI by students in learning activities and assessments.

points.quote: If individual modules have further restrictions or permit greater allowances in the use of GenAI, those restrictions or allowances must be stated in the module descriptions in the Blackboard VLE.
points.gist: Module-specific GenAI restrictions or allowances must be stated in module descriptions in the Blackboard VLE.

points.quote: In such circumstances, it is the module permissions regarding the use of GenAI which are deemed to be definitive for use in that module.
points.gist: Where a module sets its own GenAI permissions, those are the definitive ones for that module.

points.quote: All students must complete a signed declaration to be submitted with all assessed coursework, declaring that they have read and understood the Library guide on Academic Integrity and Generative AI
points.gist: Students must submit a signed declaration with all assessed coursework stating they have read the Library guide on Academic Integrity and Generative AI.

points.quote: Students should familiarise themselves with the Library Guide on Generative AI, which outlines considerations for using and acknowledging the use of Gen AI in academic work.
points.gist: Students should read the Library Guide on Generative AI, which covers using and acknowledging Gen AI in academic work.

points.quote: Staff and students of Trinity College Dublin, when using AI and GenAI, must do so in ways that are appropriate, transparent, responsible and prioritise ethical considerations
points.gist: Staff and students using AI and GenAI must do so appropriately, transparently, responsibly and with ethical considerations first.

points.quote: Trinity commits to providing ongoing resources and guidance to support students and staff in the responsible and ethical use of AI and GenAI.
points.gist: Trinity commits to ongoing resources and guidance on responsible and ethical AI and GenAI use.
